name: FILEN-027: a password database saved by another app with a safe-save replace reaches the drive
description: FILEN-027 (Filen): KeePassium saved a .kdbx through the iOS File Provider and the write never reached the drive, with no error. Rules P10 (a safe save is one change), O1. sync-chaos placeholder-write-back (the whole-file half that v1 has).

name: FILEN-027: a write through an on-demand placeholder is uploaded like any save, or the user sees an error
description: FILEN-027 (Filen): the File Provider extension dropped the write silently. Rule P13 (on-demand files are later work; when they come, a write through a placeholder uploads like any save). sync-chaos placeholder-write-back (pending).
pending: drive_pair arg on_demand (bool: macOS File Provider / Windows Cloud Files placeholders) and drive_write_through_placeholder {device, path, text} (an app writing through the placeholder); on-demand files are later work (P13)
